metadata.name: sdm_raw
metadata.comment:
It is a subset of the `BIEM_TBL` that contains the latest position for both author and submission data.

No business/dq rules have been applied to this dataset. Use this dataset to analyze the following IMPRINT(s) :

- BMC

submission_key.name: submission_key
submission_key.comment: unique submission key to distingiush submission from several source systems

author_role.name: author_role
author_role.comment: Author Role e.g. co-author, corresponding author, etc

submission_start_date.name: submission_start_date
submission_start_date.comment: Calendar date when manuscript was initially submitted

final_decision.name: final_decision
final_decision.comment: Submission final decision. Only Accepted/Rejected. Any other decision has been made blank.

final_decision_date.name: final_decision_date
final_decision_date.comment: Calendar date when final decision about submission was made

imprint_short.comment: a short code which identifies an imprint e.g. BMCE (for BioMed Central)

imprint_long.name: imprint_long
imprint_long.comment: The full name of the imprint a journal is published in e.g. BioMed Central

imprint_smc_label.name: imprint_smc_label
imprint_smc_label.comment:
imprint grouping for SMC marketing campaign purposes e.g. BioMedCentral (for BioMed Central)
[Imprint labels reference](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/180AqfJCtA9CRnFBVBk4rV7_BJ5bxElx7goTMlujEaDI/edit#gid=610015250)

metadata.name: journals
metadata.comment: Core Journals table derived from JFlow.

journal_id.name: journal_id
journal_id.comment: The Springer Nature Journal ID to reference Journals. You can use this to join to other core tables.

journal_status.name: journal_status
journal_status.comment: Status of the journal to determine whether it is active or not

publishing_model.name: publishing_model
publishing_model.comment: The type of journal- Fully Open Access, Hybrid or Subscription

publishing_unit_name.name: publishing_unit_name
publishing_unit_name.comment: Publishing Unit. More broader. eg- biology, maths, etc.

publishing_discipline_name.name: publishing_discipline_name
publishing_discipline_name.comment: Publishing Discipline. More granular titles eg- applied maths, etc

reporting_key.name: reporting_key

imprint_code.name: imprint_code
imprint_code.comment: A short code which identifies an imprint e.g. BMCE (for BioMed Central)

imprint_term.name: imprint_term
imprint_term.comment: The full name of the imprint a journal is published in e.g. BioMed Central

commercial_group.name: commercial_group
commercial_group.comment: The publisher group associated with the journal e.g. Palgrave Macmillan
